_meta.description: Hand-labelled evaluation set: 5 theses, 15 claims, one thesis per company in the corpus.
_meta.note: Verdicts are expectations written against the 10-K filings in data/raw. Re-check them if the corpus year changes.

thesis_claims.thesis_text: Apple's services business is becoming the main driver of profitability as hardware growth slows.

claims.text: Apple reports Services as a revenue category distinct from products.
Apple states that it sells its products exclusively through its own retail stores.
Apple will release a foldable iPhone within the next two years.

thesis_claims.thesis_text: Microsoft's cloud segment underpins the company's growth and margin profile.

claims.text: Microsoft identifies Intelligent Cloud as one of its reportable segments.
Microsoft states that it faces no meaningful competition in cloud services.
Microsoft's Azure market share exceeds that of Amazon Web Services.

thesis_claims.thesis_text: NVIDIA's data center business dominates its revenue mix as AI demand accelerates.

claims.text: NVIDIA identifies Data Center as a reportable revenue category.
NVIDIA manufactures all of its semiconductors in wholly owned fabrication plants.
NVIDIA's gross margin will exceed 80% in the next fiscal year.

thesis_claims.thesis_text: Visa's network model produces durable operating margins with limited credit risk.

claims.text: Visa describes operating a payments network that processes transactions.
Visa issues credit cards directly to consumers and bears the resulting credit risk.
Visa's transaction volume in India grew faster than in Brazil.

thesis_claims.thesis_text: Exxon Mobil's integrated model buffers earnings through commodity price cycles.

claims.text: Exxon Mobil identifies commodity price volatility as a risk to its results.
Exxon Mobil reports that it has exited all upstream oil and gas production.
Exxon Mobil's Guyana output will exceed one million barrels per day by 2030.
